domains.name: external authority-store concurrency
domains.purpose: external optimistic write precondition (raw authority CAS)

domains.name: Portable Plan semantic identity
domains.purpose: semantic validation and drift comparison only

D6_revision_digest_domains.candidate_raw_digest: exact intended external document identity (raw bytes + canonicalization, not normalized semantic digest)

pre_write_snapshot.applicability: required for any Portable Plan external mutation (plan_init / plan_retirement)

fields_to_capture.authority_source_revision: opaque source-provided revision at read time (e.g., Issue revision or etag); typed external CAS token
fields_to_capture.authority_observed_raw_digest: digest of raw authoritative body at read time (observed_raw_digest)
fields_to_capture.candidate_raw_digest: digest of exact intended candidate raw document (candidate_raw_digest)
fields_to_capture.normalized_plan_digest: semantic normalized digest for drift evidence (supporting evidence only, not external CAS)
fields_to_capture.raw_source_body_content: exact raw bytes to be written (candidate); buffered for readback comparison
fields_to_capture.write_target_identity: typed_target as ObjectRef or canonical string (plan_ref or issue identifier, not raw GitHub ID as Forge ID)

pre_write_snapshot.distinct_from_subject_revision: yes; subject revision is Subject aggregate CAS; do not substitute subject revision for external authority revision
pre_write_snapshot.capture_timing: after validate Subject precondition and after read external authority, before constructing PREPARED journal record

READ_BEFORE_SEQUENCE: read current raw authority via PlanAuthorityReadAdapter (bounded snapshot: body, revision, digest, control projections)
verify expected authority revision/digest against authorized precondition (raw_source_revision + observed_raw_digest)
compare to authorized precondition stored in PREPARED record
only if exactly equal, proceed to external apply; otherwise fail closed STALE_AUTHORITY with no external write

stale_precondition_rule.adapter_CAS_mapping: If adapter supports native CAS (etag/revision), map raw_source_revision to that token; otherwise enforce deterministic read-before-write + verify-after-write with no silent overwrites
